ideas.name: Weekly crypto cross-sectional reversal
ideas.claim: Cryptocurrencies with the lowest prior-week returns outperformed those with the highest prior-week returns over the following week in the reported sample.
ideas.quote: For each rebalancing frequency, we sort all cryptocurrencies into five equally-weighted quintile portfolios based on their period t return, REV, and we track their performance over the subsequent period.

rules.market: Cryptocurrencies; 200 largest by market capitalization as of December 28, 2014
rules.entry: Sort cryptocurrencies by prior-week return into five equally weighted quintiles; compare the lowest-return quintile with the highest-return quintile.
rules.filters: Remove observations with monthly turnover below 1% or the corresponding weekly rate; exclude Vertacoin.

ideas.claimed_result: The paper reports an average weekly loser-minus-winner return spread of 10.03% for January 2015 through June 2019.
required_data: Historical cryptocurrency prices across the study universe
